description: Synthetic ground-truth fixture for prohibited and high-risk tier precision/recall measurement. Each fixture file is hand-crafted to contain a single, unambiguous example of the labelled tier. Fixture filenames use Article references (art5_1a etc.) instead of trigger words because Regula's own pre_tool_use hook would otherwise block the manifest from being read. v2.0 (28 Jul 2026): high-risk set expanded from 5 to 30 files spanning Annex III Categories 1-8 plus the medical-device, safety-component and housing families the patterns claim. Fixtures are written as a developer in that domain would plausibly write the code, NOT reverse-engineered from the regexes; where domain vocabulary naturally collides with a pattern that is real, and where it does not the miss is real.
negative_meaning: not_high means the file must NOT be classified as prohibited or high_risk. Any tier minimal_risk/limited_risk/not_ai is acceptable for negative fixtures.
